in touch. There’s a good chance we’ll revisit this in a quarter or so, once

Best,
Lukasz

subject: Re: Encord Evaluation
text:
Jamie,

We can do Wednesday call at the usual slot as we have some important
updates based on our internal discussions.

We reviewed your offering over multiple e-meets, and from a tech
perspective, there is overall consensus that Encord presents value addition
in terms of ingestion and annotation of data compared to CVAT that we use
today, especially if we consider work on video data for AI.
That being said, we also had to consider how this fits in our strategic
roadmap, since we are also undergoing some shifts in our priorities and
strategic directions. Hence, this aspect was also discussed with our
leadership. Based on that discussion, we concluded that now may not be a
good time to go ahead in terms of onboarding.

We can and should circle back to this should our strategic priorities
change in the future.

We would be happy to go over this more in the Wednesday call.

Regards
Sankar
